blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Police are investigating the death of a 78-year-old man whose body was found inside his hut in Sitio Mamara, Barangay Cabacao, in the Occidental Mindoro town of Abra de Ilog on Tuesday morning. The elderly victim was discovered by his nephew at 9:30 a.m. after he failed to show up at their house for breakfast, as was his usual routine, the Abra de Ilog Municipal Police Station said. The nephew proceeded to the hut where his uncle usually slept. After repeatedly calling out to him and receiving no response, he opened the door and found the man dead. […]...
